lines.trans: Sokolov, report to me calmly and to the point.
Near Anikeev's house two suspicious people were walking.
They said that they were installing fast internet.
And what is so strange about that?
They look nothing like real technicians.
And what signs should technicians have?
They did not install any cable or equipment.
They just stood near the entrance and quickly left.
Understood. And what do you suggest doing now?
I think we urgently need reliable backup.
Yes, physical reinforcement certainly wouldn't hurt you.
When will you finally start regularly going to the gym?
Again you are joking in such a serious moment!
